title: enform instance.submitted@1 event payload
description: The payload of an instance.submitted@1 event (#43, #177, #76, #256, S06, ADR 0014, FM-4, FM-7, WF-1, S05, I2, I13, SE-2). A submit is the starter's completion of the request form, the first step of the definition. It names the instance it acts on (DX-1, #187), the request step it completed, marks the instance submitted, records the merged values (FM-7), the steps its route skipped with the condition that skipped each (S05), the next step it entered with the resolved assignees (WF-1, I13) or `done` when the request form was the last step, the Unroutable queue when every target resolved to nobody (I10), and carries the task-assigned emails and the owner alert in the same operation (I2, SE-2).

instanceId.description: The id of the instance that the submit acts on (DX-1, #187, #76).

step.description: The key of the request form, the first step, that the submit completed (ADR 0014).

currentStep.description: The key of the step the submit routed the instance to (WF-1); absent when the request form was the last step.

done.description: True when the request form was the last step, so the submit finished the instance (WF-1).

skipped.description: The steps that the submit's route skipped, in definition order, with the condition that skipped each (#192, WF-1, S05).

assignees.description: The resolved assignees of the step the submit entered, with their membership snapshots (I13, AS-4).

queue.description: The Unroutable queue when every target of the entered step resolved to nobody (I10, AS-5).

outbox.description: The side effects that the submit causes, committed with the state change (I2, SE-1, SE-2): one task-assigned email per assignee, and the owner alert of an unroutable step.

values.description: The values that the form holds: one field key to one JSON value (FM-7).

jsonValue.description: One JSON value: a string, number, boolean, null, array or object (FM-7, DF-1).

outboxEntry.description: One side effect (SE-1): the connector operation, the connector, and its payload.

skippedStep.description: One step that the route skipped, and the condition that skipped it (S05, #192).

assignee.description: One resolved assignee of a step, with the membership snapshot that resolution produced (I13, AS-4).

target.description: A task recipient: exactly one kind, per AS-1. Dynamic targets are starter, field and manager-of.
